session_note: NH's 2026 session is the second/final year of the 2025-2026 biennium; it convened 2026-01-07 and adjourned sine die on 2026-06-04 (confirmed via NRA-ILA report dated 2026-06-05 stating the General Court 'adjourned yesterday afternoon'; corroborated by Ballotpedia, Sportsmen's Alliance, and CAI Advocacy summaries citing the same June 4, 2026 date). Because 2026 is the terminal year of this biennium, NH's retained-bill/interim-study mechanisms did not carry any of these 6 bills into a further year; no special or 2027 session action was found for any of them. Two bills the packet showed as still 'active' are now confirmed dead as of the 2026-06-04 adjournment: HB1724 never received a House floor vote after its 2026-02-17 split committee report (majority ITL 10-8 / minority OTP-A) and sat in 'Miscellaneous' status through adjournment with no further docketed action; SB439 passed the Senate but was laid on the table by the full House 304-11 on 2026-05-14 and was never taken back off the table before sine die.
